question: Doljatra is a festival of which state from followings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Doljatra** is a festival celebrated in the state of **Assam**.
 
• This festival is also known as **Dol Purnima** or **Holi** in other parts of India.
 
• It is celebrated on the full moon day in the month of **Phalguna** (February-March).
 
• The festival marks the arrival of spring and is celebrated with colors, music, and dance.
 
• It holds significant cultural and religious importance in Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Holi** is celebrated across India, but it is known by different names in various regions.
 
• In West Bengal and Odisha, it is celebrated as **Dol Jatra** or **Dola Purnima**.
 
• During Doljatra, idols of Lord Krishna are placed on decorated palanquins and taken out in processions.
 
• People sing and dance to the tunes of traditional songs and throw colors at each other to celebrate the festival.
 
• The festival signifies the victory of good over evil and the arrival of spring.
